verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's first-party Change history docs say it keeps a running log of changes made to feature flags and other resources in each environment, and that the log can be used to roll back a flag. This delivers the core of an audit log for flag changes. missing for 10: explicit documentation that each entry records the actor (who), timestamp, and before/after values, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the audit log.
